big_idea: For Riyadh's busy families and professionals, Qareeb turns the familiar corner shop into a 20-minute tap. No markups, no luxury—just the everyday groceries you need, delivered from your own neighbourhood, with a simple free delivery reward every tenth time you order.
key_visual: A hand holding a smartphone in the foreground, the screen showing a grocery basket. The items—fresh vegetables, bread, and nappies—appear to leap out and land in a real Riyadh residential street, where a smiling young family receives bags from a delivery bike. A neighbourhood shop front and a 20-minute timer in the corner anchor the scene.
image_prompt: Photorealistic image, a hand holding a smartphone in the foreground, app interface displays a grocery basket with items like tomatoes, flatbread, milk, and diapers. The items visually flow from the screen into a sunlit Riyadh residential street with traditional Najdi architecture, a delivery cyclist handing a bag to a smiling Saudi couple with a child, a local ‘dokan’ shop front in the background, a digital clock showing ‘20 min’ floating like a halo, warm golden hour light, cinematic composition, 4k sharp focus.
typography: Poppins (Latin headlines and body) paired with Cairo (Arabic headlines and body, a clean modern geometric sans-serif that reads beautifully in Arabic).
